answer: Cap each funding source's influence by tracing money. Every account's vote weight is divided by the number of accounts sharing its earliest funding wallet, so a root funding N puppets gives each 1/N weight. A 1,000-puppet farm on one root has the weight of one voter. Splitting funds into separate roots means locking about 25 tokens per root and breaking the trail, which every transfer on the river of the ledger exposes. A signal from one terrace of wallets counts once.
